steps.en: Unpack the release for your GPU into an ASCII-only local path
steps.zh: 将匹配显卡的发布包解压到纯 ASCII 本地路径

steps.en: Submit an authorized video and an output file
steps.zh: 提交有权处理的视频与输出文件

steps.en: Detect mosaic regions and track overlapping clips
steps.zh: 检测马赛克区域并跟踪重叠片段

steps.en: Restore cropped clips with free BasicVSR++
steps.zh: 用免费 BasicVSR++ 修复裁剪片段

steps.en: Blend restored regions and encode the output video with audio
steps.zh: 混合修复区域并编码带音频的输出视频

value.en: A region-restored video without assembling detection, tracking and model stages yourself
value.zh: 得到局部修复视频，不必自己拼接检测、跟踪与模型阶段
